clips.title: The story
paras: Thalia Amberhide is a tauren residing at Freewind Post in the jagged canyon of Thousand Needles. A loyal friend to her kin, she waits with mounting concern for the safe return of Lakota Windsong from the clutches of the Grimtotem clan.

Perched atop the towering bluffs of Freewind Post, Thalia Amberhide is a quiet presence among the bustling tauren settlement. Her heart is heavy with worry for her close companion, Lakota Windsong, who was taken captive by Arnak Grimtotem and his treacherous kin. Thalia relies on passing Horde adventurers who brave the canyon depths to find Lakota, break her bonds, and guide her safely back up the lifts to the haven of the mesa.
